about: The repository's documents shown in Dev team, Specs and docs. The server brings them in on every start (src/server/doc-sync.ts); npm run docs:sync does the same locally. Each entry: the Markdown file, the library folder (parent/child), the kind (srs, prd, design, adr, testplan, release, runbook, postmortem, note) and the title. See docs/dev-team/SPEC-GUIDE.md, section 6.
